page.overview:
Who is Billy Eichner?

Billy Eichner is a fictionalized version of himself.

When Springfield Elementary's school newspaper is losing money, Principal Skinner assigns Billy Eichner as the new editor-in-chief, demoting Lisa to a TV recapper. He eventually turns the school newspaper online based and into a [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/BuzzFeed Buzzfeed] like website called DFG.
